definitions.explanation: The systematic process of ensuring that products or services meet defined standards of quality. Includes inspection, testing, and process management.

examples.japanese: {品質管理|ひんしつかんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{品質管理|ひんしつかんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Strict quality control is carried out at this factory.

examples.japanese: {品質管理|ひんしつかんり}{部門|ぶもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The quality control department is investigating the cause of the defective products.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧ (quality) + ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management, control). Often abbreviated as QC in Japanese business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品質管理|ひんしつかんり}{部門|ぶもん}: quality control department
- {品質管理|ひんしつかんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to ensure thorough quality control
- {品質管理|ひんしつかんり}⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: quality control standards
- {品質管理|ひんしつかんり}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: quality control system

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{品質保証|ひんしつほしょう}→品質保証：22065_hinshitsuhoshou⟧: quality assurance (QA) — broader than QC, covers the entire system for maintaining quality
- ⟦{検品|けんぴん}→検品：17217_kenpin⟧: inspection of goods — the physical act of checking products
- ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧: defective product — what quality control aims to prevent

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese manufacturing is world-renowned for its quality control practices. The concept of ⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧ (continuous improvement) and QC circles ({品質管理|ひんしつかんり}⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧), where small groups of workers regularly meet to discuss quality improvements, originated in Japanese factories and became globally influential.
